description: Concrete extraction of y_target(A_magic) from compound β-decay chain Q-values per `prop:sigma-shell-from-beta-chain-derivation`. Closed form: y_target = (Q_β^net - Σ δρ^(k)·m_e·|tr_M(β_k)|) / (m_e·|tr_M(β_ref)|). A_magic = 2 (deuteron, trivial single-link n→p chain) is fully computed using existing ρ_K and |tr_M| data from atomic-mass-via-rho-k.witness.json. A_magic = 8 (¹⁶O) is DEFERRED: AME 2020 Q-values for the ¹⁶C → ¹⁶N → ¹⁶O chain are curated in this witness, but per-link ρ_K for A∈{12..16} is not yet wired in atomic_mass_via_rho_k.py. We do NOT fabricate ρ_K values. Discrepancy with the B/(A·m_p) benchmark is documented honestly per user directive — this is a candidate audit flag, not a fitting opportunity.

rows.chain_description: Trivial single-link chain: n → p + e^- + ν̄_e. Deuteron (Z=N=1) is the bound final state.
rows.audit_note: If |relative_discrepancy| > 1, the derivation has a structural issue beyond a leading-order correction. Document but do NOT tune parameters at this layer.
rows.audit_flag: CANDIDATE AUDIT FLAG — formula needs refinement. |computed/predicted| = 10^5.36, off by more than 1 order of magnitude from B/(A·m_p) benchmark.

rows.blocker: Per-link ρ_K and |tr_M(β)| for atoms with A ∈ {12..16} are not yet computed. atomic_mass_via_rho_k.py covers only p, n, D, T, ³He, ⁴He. Extend the upstream pipeline first; do not fabricate ρ_K values for ¹⁶C/¹⁶N/¹⁶O.
